name: HYDRA-UMC-DEVELOPER-NODE
build: Python package built with python -m build (see pyproject.toml); the standard library only, plus the optional SDK extra for the verdict of a before and after run.
notes: Developer node of the HYDRA-UMC ecosystem: reads evidence bundles of the local technician (read only), keeps a cache of checkouts by revision (git worktrees over a bare mirror, with a limit in GB), runs executable repro cases and the shared CI of a workspace only after a person approved the exact plan, and writes a status document for dashboards. Every part is closed by default, every tuned value is in the configuration file and nothing leaves the machine. It has not run on a real development host yet.
